blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday said she is not expecting a “fair trial” for her father before the International Criminal Court (ICC), which is set to begin hearing the alleged crimes against humanity charges against former President Rodrigo Duterte in connection with his administration’s drug war.
